title: enforce plan scope and verification through Claude Code hooks shipped with the plugin
desc:
The scope guard only runs when the agent remembers wb impl check ("after each step or two"). Nothing stops an Edit outside the plan, or a session claiming done with no standing evidence. The plugin ships no hooks.

ACCEPTANCE:
- a PreToolUse hook on Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit refuses a path not listed in files[] of an audited, standing plan for the active ticket (resolved like wb next); paths under .workflow/ are allowed
- no active ticket or no plan: the hook allows and stays silent (does not break unrelated sessions)
- a Stop hook reports, without blocking by default, when a ticket has changed files but verify is missing or stale
- hooks are off with WB_NO_HOOKS=1 or "hooks": false in .workflow/config.json
- hook logic lives in lib/ and is unit-tested; the hook entry points are thin
